concept: Technical card on ERC-4626 vault inflation attack: a donation to the vault skews the share price so a depositor's shares round down to zero.
scene: Dark navy background with a simple diagram of a vault box. A small token labeled 1 share sits inside, a large arrow labeled donation points into the vault, and a victim deposit arrow leads out to a zero. Amber accent lines highlight the rounding step, with clean white monospace text and ample spacing.
alt_text: Diagram of an ERC-4626 vault where a direct token donation inflates the share price, so a victim's deposit is rounded down to zero shares.
